------
Order No. 06/Dated 13th September, 2024
1.

The petitioner is praying for grant of bail as he is in custody for allegedly committing offence punishable under Section 376(2)(f) of IPC and Sections 4/6 of POCSO Act, 2012, in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 23 of 2024 arising out of Parsudih P. S. Case No. 18 of 2024.
2.

entities.text: Parsudih P. S. Case No. 18 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the Doctor has opined the age of victim as 17  one year and on this, learned counsel for the petitionersubmitted that the victim has attained the age of giving consent.

She further pointed out that the allegation made against the petitioner is false and concocted one and to butress her argument, she pointed out the medical report of the victim where no sign of sexual assault has been opined by Doctor.
She also stated that sample collected during course of investigation has been sent for FSL and yet the report has not come.
Upon aforesaid premise, prayer for bail has been made.

3. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State has submitted that 164 Cr.P.C. and 161 Cr.P.C. statements of the victim clearly suggests that she has been ravished by the petitioner.

He also pointed out that during course of investigation the Investigating Officer has collected the date of birth certificate of the victim where the age of the victim has been shown as 02.05.2007 and as such the victim was minor on the date of alleged incident.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned order.

5. Perusal of the records transpires that petitioner was tutor and the victim used to go to the house of the petitioner for getting tuition and allegedly she has been ravished.
6. I have carefully perused 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim where she has categorically stated that after closing the room, petitioner committed rape on her person.

The age as per the educational certificate of the victim is 02.05.2007 and alleged incident is said to be of 09.02.2024, therefore, on the date of alleged incident, victim is 16 years, nine months and seven days only.
7. Considering the totality of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds that it is not a fit case for grant of bail.

Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is, hereby,
rejected.

(Arun Kumar Rai, J.) Umesh/-
